scope: Independent source-only peer review of the frozen owned helper smoke. No implementation edits, source execution/import, tests, unit/observer, model/native payload, network or Git operations. Hashing and parsing of selected bounded small source/metadata only; review artifact creation is the only mutation.

checks.evidence: All eight freeze entries, 85,679 bytes, and all 17 selected small source/metadata pins match size and SHA256. There are 20 unique paths in this composition. Source freeze itself matches e318783624c11706fb8a35b1d39555b783e14e43cb2f56b118d38bc863b10ff4.

The default entry prints source_only_not_ready. The parent uses stdlib and verified owner/protocol source only. The Torch/Transformers loader is reached only by the explicitly spawned fresh worker. Reviewer did not execute either branch.

ParentGate verifies the sealed-config digest, output, nonce, fixed owner05 profile/unit, current boot, admitted main start time, live parent/main identity and actual selected cgroup. It loads the exact owner05 and its fixed original boundary.

Parent checks kernel memory.max=3GiB, memory.swap.max=0, cpu.max quota=4*period, affinity16-19, and full selected unit properties/nonce/invocation/main PID at entry and arm. Original owner05 retains its R=26,119,172,916 runtime reserve, R+full3GiB initial floor, Comfy idle observer and authenticated whole-unit closure. This smoke does not replace those authorities.

Execution requires an exact acceptance JSON SHA with exactly catalog_receipt/root_execution/owner_receipt/closure/catalog_plan references. Each is checked for exact path-size-SHA. Catalog plan path/SHA is fixed. Pending acceptance contains null future refs and cannot pass this gate. No actual catalog evidence was supplied or accepted in this review.

Catalog status/completed/final authentication are joined with root exit0, owner completed/no primary or secondary errors/sources unchanged, one observed zero-exit command, closure equality, authenticated stop, exact two empty scans, absent cgroup, whole/cohort exit confirmations and continuation_authorized=false. Receipt.completed alone is insufficient.

Initial and final catalog admissions join nonce/invocation/boot and stable process fields plus exe/argv/cwd with the original owner-observed command identity. Selected sources equal the catalog plan; five module origins/versions, nine selected native paths/sizes/digests and interpreter metadata are joined. This is selected identity evidence, not full native DSO closure. Catalog source and exact selection judgments are reused from the independent cpu_followup reviews, not self-reviewed here.

Only the eight declared native package files are linked into a fresh directory; symlink paths, size drift, hash mismatch and extra names reject. Each linked file is chunk-hashed inside the future owned parent with checkpoints. Hardlink permissions are not changed, preserving the acquisition inode. No snapshot/payload operation was performed by reviewer.

Worker fixed logical interpreter, resolved path and four canonical stat fields are checked against closed catalog metadata before spawn; worker additionally verifies its actual version and fresh -B/-s state. Parent separately requires both pidfd APIs. Root must choose and pin a parent interpreter that actually provides both APIs; repository Py3.12 selection is not assumed usable. No future root command spec was reviewed.

Only the spawned child receives the fixed offline/CPU environment, overlay path and exact authority SHA. close_fds and one pass_fds descriptor provide the inherited socket. Worker rejects preimported Torch/Transformers/tokenizers and uses the closed selected interpreter. Parent environment is not rewritten.

The parent binds spawned child PPID/UID/cgroup, creates a pidfd, verifies stable PID identity around pidfd creation, writes nonce/invocation/config/boot/main-parent-worker ticket, and sends selection over its socketpair. Worker authority checks actual os.getpid/os.getppid, live start identities, UID/cgroup/unit and boot on every authority call. Secret/ticket SHA and strict monotone sequence authenticate replies.

Frozen helper01 records started at application entry and passes started+20 at the first checkpoint, before arm. Parent adopts that original absolute value, prohibits changing deadline or request ID, and requires arm deadline==started+20. It never grants a new20 at first checkpoint. Only check/arm operations exist; cancel/finish/disarm and rearm reject.

The separate parent loops on the live child and IPC, independently checks absolute whole/request deadlines, retains arm evidence, requires child exit0 plus armed request, and can SIGKILL only its identity-checked pidfd child. Parent retains the original request deadline after ASGI publication and through worker exit/parent evidence/cleanup. No worker-side disarm API exists. OS scheduling, blocking I/O and cooperative frame processing still preclude an unmeasured absolute real-time kill guarantee.

Worker calls the exact02 public load_runtime followed by public make_application with its returned runtime and durable DirectoryJournal. No fake runtime, base-global replacement or private factory bypass is present. The exact02 layer verifies frozen01 source, critical Transformer roots and weak-set registration before forwarding to the original production factory.

Original runtime uses native chat template/tokenization and greedy model.generate,128 native new tokens, original cache and selected EOS. Streamed IDs must equal returned suffix, with actual final EOS and no earlier EOS. Decode preserves raw output; raw IDs/EOS/prompt identity are retained by unchanged application journals. Hooks/checkpoints observe and can refuse; they do not synthesize logits, tokens or answers. No neural generation was executed in this review.

One fresh opaque reference is input through unchanged TEXT_VALUE, original two-message/context shape and original max_tokens1024 protocol field. Worker accepts only a complete ASGI200 response and exact JSON text equal to that fresh input reference. This equality is an assertion after the genuine native pipeline, not extraction/fallback generation. Strict JSON validation remains in unchanged original helper.

BaseException primary is re-raised. Exact child kill, child wait, receipt demotion, failure-evidence I/O and close failures are retained as notes without replacing that primary. When success cleanup alone fails it demotes the candidate then raises the cleanup failure. Original owner remains responsible for final whole-unit closure.

Candidate parent receipt is written before cleanup, but success return occurs only after socket/pidfd cleanup and explicit final whole/request deadline checks. Late success is renamed as a failed candidate, state is changed to failed_no_helper_qualification/false, and failure propagates; no success I/O occurs after the final checks. Consumers must require parent/root/owner exit success and authenticated closure, never a candidate receipt alone.

Saved log reports16 stdlib component fakes, Ruff/format and dry default pass. Source checks cover watchdog denial/expiry, identity reuse, tiny fake hardlink hashing, catalog metadata mismatch, failure evidence/demotion and dry behavior. They do not exercise a real owned parent-child run, Torch import, model generation, full end-to-end late cleanup scheduling or HTTP/browser transport. Reviewer only read source/log/validation and did not rerun any test.

Current Comfy/resource state is outside this source review; execution needs fresh original owner admission and root-selected exact inputs. No current runtime admission is inferred.

remaining_requirements_and_limits: Root must first independently accept an actually closed catalog run using the five exact evidence refs. All current future actual refs remain pending.

A concrete root command spec must select and pin a parent Python with os.pidfd_open and signal.pidfd_send_signal. Fixed worker Python remains the closed catalog interpreter; a compatible parent may use the same interpreter while remaining stdlib-only.

Fresh original owner05 admission must satisfy Comfy idle, runtime reserve R=26,119,172,916, initial R+entire3GiB=29,340,398,388, memory3GiB/swap0 andCPU16-19/quota400%. Source review grants no current admission.

A receipt is a candidate until real root/parent/owner exits and authenticated closure are independently accepted; late or cleanup failure artifacts must demote it. elapsed_seconds stored in the candidate precedes final cleanup, so actual command timing remains necessary.
The16 recorded tests are source-only component fakes; real IPC/pidfd scheduling, native runtime/hash/load cost, EOS/strictJSON generation and actual request latency are unmeasured.
In-process ASGI smoke does not qualify HTTP socket delivery, browser20 behavior, benchmark task quality, general helper quality, full native DSO closure or an absolute real-time20s kill guarantee.
Trusted frozen same-UID code and root-selected exact metadata are assumed. This source design is not a hostile-worker OS isolation claim; whole-unit closure remains original owner authority.
